study_scope: Exploratory new task on previously evaluated real image-disjoint COCO/SugarCrepe rows; frozen official CLIP. Constructed asynchronous streams, not natural video or an untouched external holdout.
source_identity: Original COCO filename, never fed to the model. Several captions and seeds of one image are correlated.
observation_order: Elapsed physical time advances, observed image enters FIFO, then observed positive text queries the current FIFO. All modalities at a time share this fixed order.
memory_policy: Shared bounded exact FIFO of observed image embeddings. No source-ID deduplication, content routing, learned reset, or hidden truth-based memory update.
targets: For alignment, every occupied slot with the query's original image is a valid answer. NONE means no such observed slot is available. Missing text has no answer target. SugarCrepe negative captions are used only against their own source image in a separate pair-ranking loss and test.
pair_features: Eight contiguous-group image/text product sums, eight group squared distances, and log1p(slot age); both embeddings are normalized. Shared learned residual on top of 20 times full cosine.
init: Paired seed; shared input map, canonical output coordinates. Ordinary put-shaped sigmoid has the same boundary value and signed derivative as the simplified put, plus the same linear path. Put+linear is a mapped evaluator of each trained Call/Put, not another fitted winner.
training_loss: Marginal log likelihood of all correct FIFO slots (or NONE) at observed queries plus 0.25 times source-image positive-versus-edited-caption softplus ranking loss; one final checkpoint only.
train_streams: Paired deterministic RNG per seed/update; 25% image drops, 20% text drops, lags 0..5, bounded irregular times. Train split only. No evaluation-driven restarts or tuning.
calibration: Existing calibration images only. Threshold is lower empirical 5th percentile of top-slot minus NONE score among source-present observed queries; report actual acceptance. Use one common calibration stream distribution per seed/model and apply frozen threshold to every test panel.
test_anchor: One final observed positive-caption query for every test caption row. Delayed-text lag varies from 1 to 3. Earlier queries are excluded from final headline denominators. Every missing-text step is excluded from query metrics. Panel construction does not enter the model.
uncertainty: Preserve all per-row and per-seed decisions. Paired bootstrap resamples original image clusters, including all captions and all fixed seeds for each sampled image; descriptive intervals on this reused subset only.
positive_claim_criterion: Call/Put improves correct alignment by at least 0.02 over ordinary on every source-present panel and does not increase absent-source false matches by more than 0.02 on either absent panel. All three seeds must meet it. This criterion is separate from unclosed HCSN scientific acceptance.
timing: Randomized interleaved full FIFO+scoring+validation CPU forward repeats at identical streams; precomputed embeddings exclude encoder/network/energy. One thread, all samples retained. No fixed-quality speed claim if traces or quality differ.
